# netbox_ipsec_proposal (Resource)

Manages a NetBox IPSec proposal (`/api/vpn/ipsec-proposals/`).

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Generated by internal/gen; edit generator/overrides to change, or remove this line to hand-maintain.
resource "netbox_tag" "example" {
  name = "example-tag"
  slug = "example-tag"
}

resource "netbox_ipsec_proposal" "example" {
  name = "example"
  description = "Managed by Terraform"
  tags = [netbox_tag.example.slug]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name.

### Optional

- `authentication_algorithm` (String) Authentication Algorithm. Valid values: `hmac-sha1`, `hmac-sha256`, `hmac-sha384`, `hmac-sha512`, `hmac-md5`. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `comments` (String) Comments. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `custom_fields` (String) Custom field values as a JSON object (`jsonencode({...})`). Only keys present in the configuration are tracked.
- `description` (String) Description. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `encryption_algorithm` (String) Encryption Algorithm. Valid values: `aes-128-cbc`, `aes-128-gcm`, `aes-192-cbc`, `aes-192-gcm`, `aes-256-cbc`, `aes-256-gcm`, `3des-cbc`, `des-cbc`. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `owner_id` (Number) ID of the Owner (`netbox_owner`).
- `sa_lifetime_data` (Number) Security association lifetime (in kilobytes).
- `sa_lifetime_seconds` (Number) Security association lifetime (seconds).
- `tags` (Set of String) Slugs of the tags assigned to this object. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.

### Read-Only

- `created` (String) Created.
- `display` (String) Display.
- `id` (Number) The numeric ID of the object in NetBox.
- `last_updated` (String) Last Updated.
- `url` (String) Url.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Generated by internal/gen; edit generator/overrides to change, or remove this line to hand-maintain.
# netbox_ipsec_proposal can be imported by its NetBox object ID.
terraform import netbox_ipsec_proposal.example 123
```
